pages.text: The Advanced and Elite Drone Frames are made of $(l)Carbon Fiber$(), as real racing drones are: light and stiff.

The $(l)Pyrolysis Oven$() splits $(l)Methane$() into carbon and hydrogen (CH4 -> C + 2H2) and draws the carbon onto $(l)String$(): $(l)250 mB of Methane + 1 String -> 1 Carbon Fiber$(), in 4 seconds at $(l)60 FE/t$(). Pipe the methane in from a

$(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l) or a gas tank, on its front, sides or back: its top is full. While it works a shuttle runs along the glowing slit, once per fiber, drawing the fiber behind it; if the shuttle stops, so has the machine.
So the gas tier is more than power: its methane is the raw material of every advanced frame.
